description: This file defines the AppShell widget responsible for initializing the app's core dependencies, managing authentication state, and rendering different screens (auth or home) based on user authentication. It sets up providers for auth and notes controllers, manages database connection, and handles bootstrap logic.

classes.name: AppShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget acting as the main shell of the app, setting up dependencies and switching between auth and home screens based on authentication state.

classes.name: _AppShellState
classes.description: Internal state class for AppShell handling bootstrap, database connection, and widget build logic.

methods.name: _bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the database and updates state accordingly, handling errors during setup.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, displaying loading, error, or the main app with providers and navigation based on authentication state.
